text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school, at Curren Bouquetd'or's request,
I watched her practice dancing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...How was it, do you think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I see...
...Thank you.
......
choice_data_list: Is there something catching your attention?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, well... Indeed, I don't believe there were any major mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However... if asked whether it was an alluring dance,
I... don't have much confidence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, her dancing was polished and orderly. But if asked whether that fully conveyed all of her charm—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then how about trying to express
what you "love" even more?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Curren... chan...?
Um, what do you mean by—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it might be faster if I just showed you!
—Ready? Don't blink, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
~~♪ ~~♪
Say cheese! Curren Smiiile☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible... She is overwhelmingly... "cute"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right? ☆ After all, I packed in so, so much
of Curren's favorite 'cuteness'☆
into it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Curren-chan's favorite thing...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪ That's why this dance
is Curren's one and only, unique to me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, what about you, Bouquet-chan? Don't you have things you love and cherish that you'd want to show everyone, too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that's right.
What I truly love is, after all...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, that's right...! Flowers—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, they've always been right by my side as a matter of course.
The ones that shaped who I am today are—flowers, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Bouquet-chan had such
a gentle smile just now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wish you'd show that smile to your fans, too.
I'm sure none of them
would be able to take their eyes off you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much, Curren-chan!
I'll give it a try—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
With feelings like... when I think about flowers.
Ah... but how am I supposed to do that—
choice_data_list: How about imagining everything around you is a flower field?
Why not just pretend to be a flower yourself?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A field of flowers spreading as far as the eye can see—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That sounds very... exciting!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The serene, ocean-like blue of baby blue eyes—and the eye-opening yellow of canola blossoms that heralds the arrival of spring.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The way it beautifully dyes the earth—
is truly the pinnacle of harmony—
choice_data_list: Incredible, I can feel the joy radiating from your whole body!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With this dance, I'm sure Bouquet-chan's
feelings of love♡ will definitely reach them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or's dance, expressing "love" with her whole body,
was thrilling even for those watching.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: M-Me, into a flower...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It feels a bit... presumptuous, but...
That's how—serious I need to be...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Like a rose: elegant, yet passionate—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Bright and full of vitality, just like a sunflower—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Pure and innocent, like a lily—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How lovely.
Bouquet-chan, you look like a bouquet yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dancing like a blossoming bouquet of flowers,
Curren Bouquetd'or kept my eyes glued to her
without a single second's distraction.
